title: Shipment History Reading Note: The Strip Shipment a Customer Holds
content:
For a take-back of test strips on the Blood Glucose Testing Supply Program, the shipment the customer holds from the program's latest strip refill is read from the program's shipment history.

**Rule.** The shipment the customer holds is the replacement shipment recorded against the latest strip refill when that refill was replaced as delivered but not received or as lost in transit (the latest replacement for non-receipt when one is on file, and otherwise the latest replacement for loss in transit), its units counted and its days of use starting on the replacement's delivery date, or today while that replacement has no proof of delivery, so that its days of use then count as none; it is nothing when the latest strip refill has no proof of delivery and no such replacement, so no units are counted as sealed; and otherwise it is the latest strip refill itself, from its own delivery date. The units already authorized for return that are taken off are those authorized against the shipment held.

| Shipment history of the latest strip refill | Shipment held | Units counted | Days of use start on |
|---|---|---|---|
| a replacement recorded against it for the reason delivered but not received | the latest such replacement | its units | its delivery date, or today while it has no proof of delivery |
| no replacement for non-receipt, but one for loss in transit | the latest replacement for loss in transit | its units | its delivery date, or today while it has no proof of delivery |
| no proof of delivery and no such replacement | nothing | none; no units are counted as sealed | — |
| any other history (delivered by proof of delivery, with no such replacement) | the latest strip refill | the refill's units | the refill's own delivery date |

**Cases (hypothetical histories)**

- A refill of 6 units shows delivered, the customer reported it not received, and a replacement of 6 units was delivered on 12 May: the replacement is held, 6 units are counted, and use is counted from 12 May.
- A refill was declared lost in transit and replaced by a shipment of 5 units: the replacement's 5 units are counted.
- A refill carries both a replacement for non-receipt and one for loss in transit: the replacement for non-receipt is held.
- The replacement has been shipped but has no proof of delivery yet: its units are counted, and its days of use start today, so they count as none.
- A refill has no proof of delivery and nothing was sent in its place: nothing is held and no units are counted as sealed.
- A refill delivered on 5 May with a replacement recorded against it for damage in transit falls in the last row, because damage in transit is not one of the two replacement reasons named; the refill itself is held from 5 May.
